The '''AA-12X VerboBrain''' was a model of [[Verbobrain/Legends|verbobrain]] manufactured by [[SyntheTech/Legends|SyntheTech Corporation]] that was mass-installed in [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]]' [[AD-series weapons maintenance droid|AD armorer droids]],<ref name="CF">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref> including [[GSAD-43]], and [[House Paramexor Squire Armorer Droid]]s.<ref name="GG">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''</ref>
